Folks — quick legal note for the file and for Ellie: 

- Redwood's baseline: we rely on the EU Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (2021) for EU->third country transfers and the UK Addendum where the exporter is UK-based. We can execute the SCCs and provide a UK addendum execution if RetailCo requires it.

- Data residency & subprocessors: primary hosting for RetailCo will be in us-east-1 (AWS) for the production tenant; cached artifacts (KV cache) may be present in edge regions per latency routing but not persisted long-term. Subprocessors currently include AWS (us-east-1), FastCache Inc. (CDN, us-west-2), and LogStream Ltd. (logging, eu-west-1). We will include a versioned subprocessors list link in the DPA.

- Encryption & keys: all customer payloads are encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Keys for hosted customers are managed in our KMS (AWS KMS) by default; for Private customers we offer customer-managed KMS/HSM. We do not hold plaintext keys for customer-managed KMS.

- Model training and retention: Redwood does not use customer payloads to improve public models by default. For hosted customers, customers can opt in to allow data to be used for service improvements; this is an explicit flag in the DPA. Short-term request traces (for routing/observability) are retained for up to 30 days; longer retention for logs is configurable under Dedicated/Private contracts.

- DPIA note: based on the initial questionnaire, RetailCo may want to perform a DPIA for profile-building use cases. If you share specifics on profiling or automated decisioning, Legal can advise on any additional mitigations.

Action items I suggest:
- Dev: complete the questionnaire with factual operational responses (hosting region, retention windows per data type).
- Laura: coordinate procurement next steps and confirm whether RetailCo requires redline or fully executed SCCs.

I'll review the completed TIA once returned and provide any redlines to the SCCs if necessary.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Ellie / Procurement team — attaching our filled questionnaire and a one-page risk mitigation summary. Key points summarized below for your packet: 

- Transfer mechanism: Redwood will execute the EU SCCs (2021) with RetailCo as data exporter/controller and Redwood as data importer/processor. We will also execute the UK Addendum where RetailCo is exporting from the UK. Attached: Redwood_SCCs_Signature_2025-06-16.pdf (executed copy).
- Hosting: production tenant for RetailCo will be us-east-1 (AWS). No model training on RetailCo payloads unless explicitly opted in.
- Subprocessors: listed in attached subprocessors CSV; primary subprocessors are AWS (us-east-1), FastCache Inc. (CDN), LogStream Ltd. (logging). We confirm subprocessors in the US.
- Encryption & keys: TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest. Default KMS is AWS KMS; customer-managed KMS available for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Retention & logs: request traces retained 30 days by default; aggregated metrics retained 2 years; we can configure retention windows per contract.
- Incident notification: Redwood will notify RetailCo within 72 hours of discovery for incidents that affect RetailCo data per our incident response SLA.
